中文摘要

持续性单侧耳痛，尤其是治疗无效并伴有脑神经体征时，应促使早期影像学检查和鼻咽部评估，以避免对伯基特淋巴瘤等侵袭性恶性肿瘤的诊断延迟。

英文摘要

Persistent unilateral otalgia, especially when refractory to treatment and associated with cranial nerve signs, should prompt early imaging and nasopharyngeal evaluation to avoid delayed diagnosis of aggressive malignancies such as Burkitt lymphoma.
